entities.name: Fall of Penregon
entities.description: The abandonment of Penregon to advancing glaciers, casting a shadow over the Dark Age.

entities.name: Penregon
entities.description: Capital of Argive in the northernmost reaches, first city to fall to the ice.

entities.name: Sylex Blast
entities.description: Event in 64 AR whose shockwave damaged Penregon.

entities.name: Kayla bin-Kroog
entities.description: Ruler who led Penregon's rebuilding and eventually evacuated it.

entities.name: Tawnos
entities.description: Built the armed civil automatons defending Penregon.

entities.name: Kher Ridges
entities.description: Mountains in whose shadow Penregon lay.

entities.name: Myrel
entities.description: Kayla's guard captain, sent on an expedition.

entities.name: Ice Age
entities.description: Era whose glaciers claimed Terisiare's holdings.

entities.name: Terisiare
entities.description: Continent claimed by the Ice Age.

entities.name: Dark Age
entities.description: New era overshadowed by the Fall of Penregon.

events.summary: Penregon is damaged by the Sylex Blast's shockwave and Kayla bin-Kroog begins rebuilding.
events.quote: rebuilding efforts by Kayla bin-Kroog were initiated

events.summary: The Church of Tal besieges Penregon in 69 AR but fails against Tawnos's automatons.
events.quote: the siege was unsuccessful through the use of armed civil automatons built by Tawnos

events.summary: Glaciers grow each year and scouts find warmer lands to the southwest.
events.quote: Scouts also found greener pastures to the southwest

events.summary: Kayla sends her people away each year and sends guard captain Myrel on an expedition.
events.quote: Kayla sent more of her people away each year

events.summary: Kayla leaves with the last group; the stubborn holdouts stay and are taken by the ice.
events.quote: the last holdouts stayed counting their gold until the ice took them

relations.quote: armed civil automatons built by Tawnos defending the city
the Siege of Penregon by the Church of Tal
